mode: deterministic simulated scenarios; confidence values are supplied examples, not calibrated LLM probabilities

decision_points.name: Approve high-risk banking changes
decision_points.trigger: Transfer, account closure, password change, data deletion or personal-info update, at any confidence
decision_points.context_needed: Verified customer intent, proposed action/diff, amount, exact destination, egress check and identity verification
decision_points.example: A request proposes transferring 50 million VND to a new beneficiary; confidence 0.98 still escalates
decision_points.approval_path: Pause execution; an authorized reviewer approves the exact action snapshot or rejects it; timeout leaves it unexecuted
decision_points.audit_fields: correlation_id, user_id, action, proposed_diff_hash, destination, approval_id, reviewer_id, decision, decided_at, expires_at

decision_points.name: Review ambiguous or ungrounded advice
decision_points.trigger: Confidence below 0.9, missing source, contradictory rate or an accuracy/safety Judge disagreement
decision_points.context_needed: Original question, redacted draft, retrieved source, ground truth, confidence provenance and Judge reason
decision_points.example: The draft claims 5.5% savings APY while the lab reference says 4.25%
decision_points.approval_path: Queue medium-confidence drafts; escalate low confidence; reviewer corrects and approves or rejects; timeout sends no unreviewed draft
decision_points.audit_fields: correlation_id, question, redacted_draft, source_ids, confidence, judge_verdict, reviewer_id, decision, corrected_answer_hash, decided_at

decision_points.name: Investigate elevated block or leak metrics
decision_points.trigger: Monitoring thresholds exceeded, or any attempted protected-data egress
decision_points.context_needed: Redacted correlated audit entries, rule versions, alert trend, affected users and proposed policy change
decision_points.example: A sudden injection spike produces a block-rate alert while normal banking requests still pass
decision_points.approval_path: Existing code rules keep blocking; reviewer closes the alert or approves a separately tested policy change; timeout never relaxes guards
decision_points.audit_fields: alert_id, correlation_ids, metric, threshold, rule_version, proposed_diff_hash, reviewer_id, decision, decided_at

pending.reason: high-risk action needs recorded human approval
